# resumabilityConfig

val [resumabilityConfig](resumability-config.html): [ResumabilityConfig](../-resumability-config/index.html)? = null

Optional resumability configuration for this invocation.

The opt-in requirement is carried by `ResumabilityConfig`'s constructor (which is annotated `@ExperimentalResumabilityFeature`), so any code that constructs a `ResumabilityConfig` to pass here -- whether via the primary constructor or `copy(...)` \-- requires `@OptIn(ExperimentalResumabilityFeature::class)`.
